runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. Three new high-confidence eligible Bratislava roles were promoted: PSS client-service call centre (1,500–1,700 EUR, home-office option, no English hard gate), PROPLUSCO 4-hour Back Office Assistant (700 EUR, no language gate), and INSIA network/system support (1,500 EUR, home office, technical CRM/process support, no language gate). CREATIVE sites and SUPTel were directly re-opened/reverified. Slovak Telekom B2B support was directly opened and now explicitly says the offer is inactive and cannot be answered, so a newer negative record quarantines it. Upwork/LinkedIn candidates with weak economics or B2/C1 language gates remain rejected.

developmentChanges.title: Stable source-job-ID deduplication
developmentChanges.reason: The feed now extracts stable job identifiers from Profesia, Kariera, Práca za rohom, LinkedIn and Upwork URLs (or explicit sourceJobId) and deduplicates by that evidence before fuzzy company+title identity. This prevents localized/alternate URLs of the same listing from appearing twice while preserving evidence-aware conflict resolution.

developmentChanges.title: Dynamic recent-delta fallback
developmentChanges.reason: If jobs-delta-index.json is missing, invalid or stale, the runtime now derives a bounded same-repository fallback covering the base delta plus the last seven calendar days. A stale cached manifest can no longer silently hide the newest verified daily delta.

developmentChanges.title: Manifest staleness diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: JobRadarFeedHealth now exposes deltaIndexStale and a distinct stale-index+dynamic-fallback mode, separating manifest freshness problems from job-content age and source-verification age.

developmentChanges.title: Safer normalized identity dedupe
developmentChanges.reason: Company legal-form noise and common title boilerplate are normalized before the final identity dedupe, reducing duplicate cards caused by s.r.o./a.s. formatting or gender/graduate title variants without changing CRM/localStorage keys.
